g.text: CORE PRINCIPLE: THE BIRTH OF THE BELL CURVE

text.tspan: Single dice have flat uniform distributions (each face is 1/6). But when two dice add together,
extreme sums require extreme coordination, while central sums have many different additive combinations!
This combinatorial clustering is the foundation of the normal distribution Bell Curve!
Count all 2d6 combinations that give an EVEN sum (2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12). Exactly 18 out of 36
outcomes! P = 50.0%! (Scan QR for 3D animated solution!)
